Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 1

“Arjuna said: If you consider understanding better than action, Janardana, then why do you urge me to this terrible deed, Keshava?”

Arjuna catches what sounds like a contradiction and says so. Chapter 2 praised buddhi-yoga above mere action, yet ended by ordering him into battle. His objection is sharp and entirely fair.
